deliverables: DeFi Kernel registry website and submission process
Public documentation, registry metadata, reports, security review or audit before mainnet releases, and KPI reporting
request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Dano Finance requests treasury funding to accelerate the DeFi Kernel as an open standard for shared liquidity, on-chain financial intents, and global order-book coordination on Cardano, alongside two DeFi primitives and an SDK.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA total, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA for a 1% budget administration fee.

The delivery budget is allocated as 300,000 ADA for the DeFi Kernel registry and 1,000,000 ADA each for the Spot Leverage Order Book, American Options Protocol, and Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.
Minswap Labs will serve as budget administrator for fund administration, milestone review, and accountability.
Dano Finance says it currently has approximately USD 18 million in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.
The DeFi Kernel registry is intended to be open, fee-free, royalty-free, and available without listing fees, certification fees, revenue share, or mandatory smart-contract open-sourcing.
The Spot Leverage Order Book will support leveraged spot trading orders involving collateral, borrowing, debt accounting, position management, risk parameters, and settlement.

The American Options Protocol will use an extended concentrated-pool model for American options market-making with option-specific strike, expiry, premium, collateral, exercise, settlement, and LP risk accounting behavior.
The SDK will provide registry schema reading, metadata parsing, discovery helpers, transaction construction helpers, adapters, examples, tests, and documentation for DeFi Kernel-compatible contracts.

The proposal sets KPIs of USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the Spot Leverage Order Book and USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day option notional volume for the American Options Protocol within 90 days of mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.

Dano Finance says it will return 5% of protocol fees from the treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after specified direct costs, and report this publicly.

summary: The proposal is a 3,333,000 ADA treasury withdrawal for Dano Finance to build DeFi Kernel registry infrastructure, two Cardano DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with Minswap Labs as administrator and milestone, audit, reporting, KPI, unused-fund, and limited fee-return commitments stated in the document.
